newsitem.title: USA: Inspectors asked to recount Ahmanson consents.
newsitem.headline: Inspectors asked to recount Ahmanson consents.

text.p: Great Western Financial Corp said the Corporation Trust Co has been asked to again count shareholder consents on proposals three, four and five in the H.F. Ahmanson and Co solicitation.

Great Western said both it and Ahmanson asked for a count as of the end of each day from April 9 to April 15. Inspectors have also been asked by both parties to produce a preliminary report of the new tabulations, Great Western said.

Great Western said Ahmanson's counsel has sent a letter to Corporation Trust requesting that 5.2 million shares submitted by Ahmanson which were voted twice by a stockholder be eliminated from the count. A similar request was made by counsel for Great Western.
Ahmanson"s proposal number three calls for the Great Western bylaws to be amended to require that the annual meeting be held on the fourth Tuesday in April or within 14 days of that date.

Proposal number four calls for an amendment to the Great Western bylaws to provide that holders of a majority of the stock having voting power, whether in person or by proxy, to constitute a quorum. Proposal number five would amend the bylaws to prevent any of the other consents that are approved from being amended or repealed without an affirmative vote by a majority of the shareholders.

On April 21, Great Western said a preliminary tabulation showed 53 percent of the outstanding shares backed proposals three, four and five. Subsequently, Great Western said there was a double counting of 5.2 million shares. Great Western has about 137.7 million shares outstanding.
Great Western agreed to a merger with Washington Mutual Inc after Ahmanson launched a bid for Great Western earlier this year.
